blank_probability_profile.short_vowel_200ms: Blank probability is high only at phoneme boundaries (ranges from 0.05 to 0.45). Character token probabilities peak at 0.85-0.98 during vowel core.
blank_probability_profile.long_madd_vowel_gt_800ms: By 400ms into the Madd, token probability for 'ا' decays exponentially from 0.92 down to 0.02. Blank [PAD] token probability jumps to 0.98 and remains locked there until the next acoustic consonant.

observation.repeated_token_collapsing: Wav2Vec2 relies on standard CTC collapsing rules where identical consecutive tokens (e.g., 'ااا') are merged into a single token unless separated by a blank token. In prolonged Madd, the absence of intervening consonants or blanks results in a single collapsed character representation, which makes it impossible to distinguish between short vowels and elongated vowels based on token repetition count.
